meta.source: NASA POWER (Prediction Of Worldwide Energy Resources), monthly point data, community AG
meta.parameters: PRECTOTCORR (rain, mm/day, turned into mm per month), T2M_MAX, T2M_MIN (degrees C)
meta.note: Modelled values for a point at the centre of each district on a coarse grid (about 0.5 degrees). Not rain-gauge records; do not use for local or farm-level decisions.
meta.citation: These data were obtained from the NASA Langley Research Center (LaRC) POWER Project funded through the NASA Earth Science/Applied Science Program.
